s1.syndrome_frame: a gradually enlarging, red, cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule on the upper arm
salient_findings: red tumor on the right upper arm
no history of local trauma or insect bite
key_facts: 16-year-old girl
previously healthy
red tumor on the right upper arm
tumor enlarged over 6 months
no history of local trauma or insect bite
personal, past, and family histories were unremarkable
6 × 6-cm protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red bullalike tumor
nontender, firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor
no regional lymphadenopathy
normal laboratory tests
multilocular spaces below the epidermis and a solid tumor in the deep dermis
basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis
dilated lymphatic vessels in the dermis above the tumor

shortlist.label: Pilomatrixoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches clinical description of a red, cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule and histological findings of basophilic cells and shadow cells

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with a gradually enlarging, protuberant tumor with a hard nodule

shortlist.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: possible given the tumor's multilocular appearance and firm-to-hard nodule

shortlist.label: Cylindroma
shortlist.why_kept: considered due to the tumor's solid appearance and lobulated cut surface

shortlist.label: Sclerodermiform pilomatricoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches the clinical and histological features, including the presence of shadow cells

raw.rationale: The presence of basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis, along with the description of a multilocular tumor with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance, are characteristic features of pilomatrixoma.

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: Typically presents with a history of local trauma and has a more infiltrative growth pattern

rejected.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
rejected.why: Usually associated with neurofibromatosis type 1 and has a distinct plexiform morphology

rejected.label: Cylindroma
rejected.why: Typically presents as multiple small tumors and has a distinct cylindrical morphology

rejected.label: Sclerodermiform pilomatricoma
rejected.why: A rare variant of pilomatrixoma, but the described features do not specifically suggest sclerodermiform characteristics
